problem.title: Frog Jump with K Distance
problem.problemStatement: A frog stands on the first stone and may jump forward up to K stones at a time. The energy cost of a jump is the absolute difference between the heights of the starting and destination stones. Determine the minimum total energy required to reach the last stone.
problem.input: • First line contains integers N and K. • Second line contains N integers.
